items.title: Tom McIntosh — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ina Ray Hutton, that’s Benny Hutton’s sister.

ctx.x: She played trumpet coming out of the Louis Armstrong School. The Nazi party put her in prison. However, they made a deal with the U.S. government to release her in exchange for three German prisoners of war.
Was the woman’s name Ina Ray Hutton, was that her name?
